home.layout: Full-bleed 85vh hero photo with overlaid serif headline, followed by 3-column membership tier cards, member stat band, events preview row, 3-column testimonials in Caveat, and terracotta Book a Tour CTA section.

spaces.layout: Editorial intro header then masonry-style photo gallery grid (2-3 columns) of space cards with documentary photos, capacity, amenities icons and availability badges, plus virtual tour and floor plan PDF buttons.

membership.layout: Centered header with annual/monthly toggle, 4-column pricing cards with most-popular badge on Dedicated Desk, followed by full-width feature comparison checklist grid.

community.layout: 3-column featured member spotlights with candid photos and Caveat quotes, 4-card upcoming events row, 40+ partner perks logo grid with discount tags, and Slack waitlist form section.

events.layout: Monthly calendar grid widget at top with event dots, filter chip row, vertical list of upcoming workshops with facilitator photos and RSVP buttons, and past events photo strip at bottom.
